description: Publishing plan for queued uploads: they become public automatically - right after their upload (every_hours 0) or one library entry per slot from start every every_hours hours (YouTube's scheduled publishing; DE and EN of an entry share a slot). ALWAYS parked for approval; runs only after a human admin approves it - in the app, or on the human's explicit request via resolve_pending_tool_call {human_request} with their own API key (never as an agent). publish:false removes the plan (uploads stay private).

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id (UC…) from list_youtube_channels; optional when only one channel is connected

every_hours.description: hours between slots; 0 = public right after upload (default 0)

publish.description: false removes the plan; default true

start.description: ISO date-time of the first slot; default now

upload_ids.description: default: every queued or running upload of the channel, in queue order

name: schedule_youtube_publishing
